newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: One, three and six-month Saudi t-bill rates mixed.
newsitem.headline: One, three and six-month Saudi t-bill rates mixed.

text.p: Yields were mixed at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering of treasury bills worth three billion riyals, bankers said on Monday.

The yield on 28-day bills was stable at 5.4217 percent while the rate on 91-day paper climbed to 5.4360 percent from 5.4201 percent and the yield on 182-day bills was up at 5.5444 percent from 5.4791 percent.
One and three-month interbank rates were put at 5-9/16, 7/16 percent and six months were at 5-11/16, 9/16 percent.
